text.aria-label: Lateral pterygoid (behind) — 翼外肌（在后方）
Origin area — 起点区
Insertion area — 止点区
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Lateral pterygoid — 翼外肌
Origin: greater wing of the sphenoid (superior head); lateral surface of the lateral pterygoid plate (inferior head) — 起点：蝶骨大翼（上头）；翼突外侧板外侧面（下头）
text.tspan: Origin: greater wing of the sphenoid (superior head); lateral surface of the lateral pterygoid plate (inferior head)
起点：蝶骨大翼（上头）；翼突外侧板外侧面（下头）

text.aria-label: Insertion: pterygoid fovea on the neck of the mandible; joint capsule and disc — 止点：下颌颈的翼肌凹；关节囊和关节盘
text.tspan: Insertion: pterygoid fovea on the neck of the mandible; joint capsule and disc
止点：下颌颈的翼肌凹；关节囊和关节盘

text.aria-label: Medial pterygoid — 翼内肌
Origin: medial surface of the lateral pterygoid plate; tuberosity of the maxilla — 起点：翼突外侧板内侧面；上颌结节
text.tspan: Origin: medial surface of the lateral pterygoid plate; tuberosity of the maxilla
起点：翼突外侧板内侧面；上颌结节

text.aria-label: Insertion: medial surface of the ramus and angle of the mandible — 止点：下颌支和下颌角内侧面
text.tspan: Insertion: medial surface of the ramus and angle of the mandible
止点：下颌支和下颌角内侧面
